_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct and 5 Nov) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (kingshotguides.com Drill Camp guide, 2025-03-25).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons. Which book upgrades which skills comes from a guide, because the screens show only icons: Conquest Skill Books upgrade Conquest skills (Arena and Conquest stages) and Expedition Skill Manuals upgrade Expedition skills (marches and rallies); until 5 Nov the names were swapped here. A skill's level is capped by stars: your screens show the cap is one more than the stars (1★ → Lv 2 … 3★ → Lv 4), and a guide confirms Lv 5 needs 4★.
skillBooks.source: You, 25 Oct (shared stock); heaven-guardian.com and kingshotmastery.com, read 5 Nov (book names, Lv 5)
skillBooks.confidence: Verified (shared stock, star caps on your screens); Unverified (book names)

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

recommendations.what: First KvK 28 Nov – 7 Dec: keep the save list for it
recommendations.summary: A server tracker puts your first Kingdom vs Kingdom on 28 Nov – 7 Dec, before your 1 Dec no-speedups date. Ask the alliance when the saved speedups are to be used.
recommendations.why: The kingshotmastery.com Server Timeline for Kingdom 2508 (read 20 Nov) lists the First Kingdom of Power (KvK) on 28 Nov – 7 Dec, server days 70–79. The game showed no KvK date on the screens read, and the site says dates can shift. Your alliance's "KVK: WHAT TO SAVE" list (18 Nov) covers speedups; gems, Roulette spins and hero shards; Mithril, Widgets and Forgehammers; Governor Charm and Governor Gear items; Taming Marks, pet food and items. Its other request, no speedups until 1 Dec, ends three days into KvK, so when the saved items are spent is the alliance's call. Saved now: General 4 h 36 min, Training 15 h 27 min, Construction 3 days 19 h 25 min, Research 11 h 36 min and Healing 2 days 17 h 8 min of speedups and 33,029 gems (20 Nov); Mythic 24 and Epic 6 Redeem shards (17 Nov). The same tracker puts Generation 2 Pets (Cheetah, Moose) on 30 Nov.
steps: Keep every item on the alliance's save list unused; no play task spends them.
Ask the alliance whether speedups may be used in KvK before 1 Dec, and on which day.
On 28 Nov, check Events → Calendar for the KvK dates (the tracker's dates can shift).
evidence: profile.md Server timeline, 20 Nov: First Kingdom of Power 28 Nov – 7 Dec (days 70–79), Generation 2 Pets 30 Nov (kingshotmastery.com, Unverified)

recommendations.summary: No upgrades until 1 Dec, and research first. After that, Town Center 24 raises the hero level cap to 74 (Jabel is capped at 69) and leads to Drill Camp slot 10 at Town Center 25.
recommendations.why: The side panel showed Building Queue 1 and 2 Idle on 20 Nov, and the quest bar says "Upgrade Town Center to Lv. 24". Jabel is at Lv 69 (hero screen, 20 Nov), the cap at Town Center 23; on 17 Nov her screen said the next level needs Town Center 24. Community tables give a Lv 74 cap at Town Center 24 (Unverified). The Drill Camp's slot 10 needs Town Center 25. Your alliance asks members not to use speedups until 1 Dec (told by the account owner on 18 Nov), so the 3 days 19 h 25 min of construction speedups (20 Nov) stay saved and the upgrade runs on its own time. The account owner plans to finish all research first and has time (18 Nov), so this waits.

Upgrade any required building below 23 with the second queue, then the Town Center.
Do not use construction speedups until 1 Dec (alliance request).

recommendations.what: Hero XP: Chenko, Olive, Quinn and Diana to Lv 69
recommendations.summary: Olive and Quinn reached Lv 68 by 20 Nov, so the 9 Drill Camp heroes are at 68. When the four Lv 68 instructors all reach 69, the 9 rise to 69 for free.
recommendations.why: Drill Camp on 20 Nov: instructors Jabel 69, Chenko 68, Olive 68, Quinn 68 and Diana 68, so the Level Minimum is 68 and the 9 slotted heroes (Amane, Helga, Howard, Gordon, Yeonwoo, Fahd, Forrest, Saul, Seth) are Lv 68. They auto-level to the lowest instructor, so the minimum moves to 69 only when the last of the four reaches 69, the Town Center 23 cap (Jabel is there already). Four levels of XP then give 13 heroes a level; XP on any other hero levels only that hero. One level near Lv 68 costs about 670,000 (Diana's Upgrade button, 17 Nov), so the four need about 2.7M; you have 600.63K (Backpack overview, 20 Nov). The earlier card, Olive and Quinn to Lv 68, is done.
steps: After 1 Dec, put Hero XP only into Chenko, Olive, Quinn and Diana until all four are Lv 69.
Then check Heroes → Drill Camp: the Level Minimum should read 69.

recommendations.what: Mythic books: save them for Jabel, not Saul
recommendations.summary: Saul is 1 book from Lv 4 (49 / 50), but he only gathers stone (Sto). Jabel is in both Arena squads, Barricade 1, the Guard Station, Ter and Att; her Gallant Throw needs 75.
recommendations.why: Mythic books are one shared stock for Jabel, Saul and Helga. Saul's Final Prayer and Superior Techniques need 50 Mythic Conquest Books (you have 49, 17 Nov), but Saul is only in Sto (stone gathering), and Conquest skills work only in the Arena and Conquest stages. Jabel is in the Arena attack and defense squads, Barricade 1, the Guard Station, Ter and Att (20–21 Nov); her Gallant Throw goes from 234% to 252% at Lv 5 for 75 books. Helga's skills are capped until 2-Star.
steps: Do not upgrade Saul's Conquest skills.
Keep Mythic Conquest Books until you have 75, then upgrade Jabel's Gallant Throw.

recommendations.summary: Quinn is in both Arena squads, Barricade 1, the Guard Station and Att. At 50 books, Natural Selection goes to +25% damage and Precision Shot to +40%.
recommendations.why: Every Epic skill that can be raised now needs 50 books (Lv 3 → 4) or 75 (Lv 4 → 5); you have 38 Epic Conquest Books and 43 Epic Expedition Manuals (17 Nov). In the Arena, Quinn and Diana are in both squads, Chenko only in the attack and Gordon only in the defense; all four have Lv 3 Conquest skills. Quinn's Natural Selection raises all his damage (+20% → +25%); Diana's Lv 3 skills raise only her attack speed and crit rate. Of the heroes in the attack march (Att), only Quinn has a Lv 3 Expedition skill: Precision Shot, a 50% chance of +30% → +40% damage for the whole march. The rally preset Ter (Diana, Howard, Jabel) has no Epic skill that 50 manuals can raise: Howard's are Lv 4 and Diana's are hunting skills.
steps: At 50 Epic Conquest Books: Quinn → Skills → Natural Selection → Upgrade.
At 50 Epic Expedition Manuals: Quinn → Skills → Precision Shot → Upgrade.
